rationale: For each meal, computes HENI minutes / HEFI score / HSR stars and checks (a) Spearman rank correlation across systems >= 0.6 and (b) per-meal expected_quality direction matches.

meals.label: Processed-meat anti-pattern
meals.rationale: High sodium, high sat fat, processed meat. Should rank BELOW midpoint on all 3 systems.

meals.label: Refined-sugar dessert
foods: Dessert, frozen, ice cream, vanilla, rich, 16% M.F.
meals.rationale: High free sugars, sat fat, low protein. Should rank low on HEFI sugars/sat-fat, low HSR (other-food cat), HENI mildly negative.

meals.label: Mixed-balanced lunch
foods: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained, salted
meals.rationale: Standard mixed lunch: whole grain, lean protein, veg, fruit. Should rank mid-to-high on all 3 systems.

meals.label: Plant-forward dinner
meals.rationale: Whole grain + plant protein + 2 vegetables. Should rank HIGH on all 3 systems.

meals.label: Sardines + greens (HENI +ve extremum)
foods: Fish, sardine, Pacific, canned in tomato sauce
meals.rationale: Omega-3-rich sardines + dark leafy + fruit. HENI Fig 4 sardine extremum is +82 min/serving; HEFI/HSR should also score high.

meals.label: Sweet-beverage + refined-grain breakfast
foods: Milk, fluid, chocolate, partly skimmed, 2% M.F.
meals.rationale: SSB + refined grain + sat fat. Should rank low across all 3 systems on Beverages, Sugars, Sodium components.

caveats: HENI scores affected by extraction bugs (PUFA 10x, sodium inflation, food-mass-as-nutrient confusion) surfaced in _smoke_heni_literature_panel_results.json. Cross-system rank correlations involving HENI are expected to be distorted.
